title: PM-KISAN
objective: Yearly income support for landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Farmer families that hold cultivable land in their names, unless they fall under the scheme's exclusion categories (for example certain higher-income groups). Check the exclusion list in the official FAQ.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year per family, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 every four months, directly into the bank account.
how_to_apply: Register on pmkisan.gov.in using 'New Farmer Registration', or go to a Common Service Centre, or approach the village revenue official (patwari). e-KYC is mandatory to keep receiving payments.
documents_required: Aadhaar; Bank account linked to Aadhaar; Land ownership records; Mobile number
summary_en: If your family owns farmland, this scheme sends Rs 6,000 a year straight to your bank account in three parts. You must register, complete e-KYC, and your family must not fall in an excluded group. Check your status on the official site before relying on a payment.
summary_hi: अगर आपके परिवार के पास खेती योग्य ज़मीन है, तो यह योजना आपके बैंक खाते में प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 तीन समान किश्तों में सीधे भेजती है। योजना का लाभ निरंतर प्राप्त करने के लिए e-KYC पूरा करना अनिवार्य है।

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Authority)
objective: Free hospital treatment cover for eligible poor families and for all citizens aged 70 and above.
eligibility: Families identified under the scheme's criteria (based on the SECC 2011 data), and every citizen aged 70 or above regardless of income through the Ayushman Vay Vandana card.
benefits: Cashless cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment at empanelled hospitals. Seniors aged 70+ in families already covered get an extra top-up of up to Rs 5 lakh for themselves.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the official PM-JAY site or the Ayushman app, then get your card through the app or portal, a Common Service Centre, or an empanelled hospital. Seniors aged 70+ can self-register for the Vay Vandana card.
summary_en: This scheme pays for hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year per family at listed hospitals, without you paying upfront. Poor families that meet the official criteria are covered, and anyone aged 70 or above can get a card whatever their income. Treatment must be at an empanelled hospital.
summary_hi: यह योजना सूचीबद्ध अस्पतालों में पात्र गरीब परिवारों तथा 70 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के सभी वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज प्रदान करती है।

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
objective: Clean cooking gas connections for women in poor households.
eligibility: An adult woman (18 years or older) from an eligible poor household that does not already have an LPG connection.
benefits: A deposit-free LPG connection in the woman's name. Under Ujjwala 2.0, the first refill and a stove are also free.
how_to_apply: Apply through pmuy.gov.in or give the filled KYC form and documents to a nearby LPG distributor. The connection is released after verification.
documents_required: Aadhaar; Ration card or equivalent household proof; Bank account details; Filled KYC application form
summary_en: This scheme gives eligible women a gas connection without a security deposit, plus a free stove and first cylinder refill under Ujjwala 2.0. Later refills are paid by the family. Only households with no existing LPG connection can apply.
summary_hi: यह योजना पात्र गरीब परिवारों की वयस्क महिलाओं को बिना सुरक्षा जमा के मुफ्त एलपीजी गैस कनेक्शन, पहला भरा सिलेंडर और चूल्हा प्रदान करती है।

title: National Education Policy 2020
objective: National framework to reform school and higher education.
eligibility: Not an application-based scheme. It is a policy that applies to schools, colleges and universities, and is carried out by the Centre and state governments.
benefits: Replaces the old 10+2 school structure with a 5+3+3+4 structure (ages 3-8, 8-11, 11-14, 14-18), stresses basic reading and maths in early years, flexible multidisciplinary choices, and use of the home language or mother tongue in the early years.
how_to_apply: No application is needed. Changes reach students through their schools, boards and universities. Follow the Ministry of Education for official documents and updates.
summary_en: NEP 2020 is the Government of India's plan for how school and college education should work. It was approved by the Union Cabinet on 29 July 2020. Its main change is a new school structure covering ages 3 to 18, with more focus on early learning and flexible subject choices. Each state decides the pace of its own rollout.
summary_hi: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति 2020 भारतीय शिक्षा प्रणाली में 5+3+3+4 संरचना लागू करती है, जिसमें प्रारंभिक वर्षों में मातृभाषा में शिक्षा और कौशल विकास पर विशेष ध्यान दिया गया है।

title: Atal Pension Yojana
objective: Guaranteed monthly pension after age 60, mainly for unorganised-sector workers.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank or post office account. From 1 October 2022, anyone who is or has been an income-tax payer cannot join.
benefits: A guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 per month from age 60, as chosen at joining. The same pension continues to the spouse. Monthly contribution depends on the age at joining and the pension chosen.
how_to_apply: Go to your bank or post office branch (or use net banking or the bank's app) and fill the APY form. Contributions are auto-debited from your savings account each month.
documents_required: Savings bank or post office account; ID proof (Aadhaar is commonly used); Mobile number
summary_en: You pay a small amount every month while working, and from age 60 you receive a fixed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000, depending on the plan you choose. The earlier you join, the less you pay each month. Income-tax payers cannot join.
summary_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों के लिए एक निश्चित पेंशन योजना, जिसमें 18 से 40 वर्ष की आयु में जुड़ने पर 60 वर्ष की आयु से ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 की गारंटीशुदा मासिक पेंशन मिलती है।

title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
objective: Loans for small non-farm businesses.
eligibility: Individuals and small businesses in manufacturing, trading or services that need a loan of up to Rs 20 lakh. Tarun Plus is only for borrowers who have fully repaid an earlier Tarun loan.
benefits: Loans in four bands: Shishu up to Rs 50,000, Kishore above Rs 50,000 up to Rs 5 lakh, Tarun above Rs 5 lakh up to Rs 10 lakh, and Tarun Plus above Rs 10 lakh up to Rs 20 lakh. Interest rates and fees are set by each lender.
how_to_apply: Apply at a bank, NBFC or microfinance institution, or through the Udyamimitra portal linked from mudra.org.in. Choose the band that matches your funding need.
documents_required: Identity proof; Address proof; Business proof or simple business plan; Bank statements (usually asked for larger loans)
summary_en: Mudra loans help small shops, workshops and service businesses get money to start or grow. The size of the loan decides the category, from Shishu (small) up to Tarun Plus. You apply to a bank or lender, which decides approval and interest.
summary_hi: गैर-कॉर्पोरेट और गैर-कृषि लघु उद्यमियों व छोटे व्यवसायों के लिए बैंकों और वित्तीय संस्थानों के माध्यम से ₹20 लाख तक का आसान ऋण उपलब्ध कराने की योजना।

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
objective: Help urban families buy, build or rent a pucca home.
eligibility: Urban families in the EWS (income up to Rs 3 lakh), LIG (Rs 3-6 lakh) or MIG (Rs 6-9 lakh) groups per year, with no pucca house anywhere in India in the family's name. A beneficiary can use only one vertical.
benefits: Central assistance of up to Rs 2.50 lakh per unit, and an interest subsidy on eligible home loans sanctioned on or after 1 September 2024. Verticals include building on your own land, affordable housing in partnership, affordable rental housing and the interest subsidy scheme.
how_to_apply: Apply on the official PMAY-U 2.0 portal after reading the instructions for your vertical. Keep Aadhaar and income details ready.
documents_required: Aadhaar; Income details or proof; Bank account details
summary_en: This scheme helps city families without a pucca house to build, buy or rent one. How much help you get depends on your yearly household income group and the vertical you choose. Rural families should look at PMAY-Gramin instead, which is a separate scheme.
summary_hi: शहरी गरीब और मध्यम वर्गीय परिवारों (EWS, LIG, MIG) को पक्का घर खरीदने, निर्माण करने या किफायती किराए पर लेने के लिए वित्तीय सहायता और ब्याज सब्सिडी देती है।

title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
objective: Law protecting people's digital personal data.
eligibility: Applies to every person whose digital personal data is handled by an organisation. No application is needed.
benefits: You can ask an organisation for information about your data, ask for corrections and deletion, nominate someone to act for you, and complain to the Data Protection Board. Organisations must respond to requests within a maximum of 90 days.
how_to_apply: First contact the organisation that holds your data using its grievance process. If you are not satisfied, complain to the Data Protection Board. Check the MeitY site for the current process.
summary_en: This law gives you rights over the digital data that companies and government bodies collect about you, and sets duties for them. Parliament passed the Act in August 2023 and the Rules were notified in November 2025, with some parts taking effect in stages. It is a law, not a benefit scheme.
